method: City of Newport News footprint 'Jefferson Lab #999-01' used verbatim: a strip about 265 m long and 4.5-5 m wide, the northern of the two parallel straight sections of the racetrack. JLab's site plan labels '999 Accelerator Tunnel' twice and lists '01 North LINAC' and '02 South LINAC'; the city's part numbers -01 and -02 and the north/south positions match, but the equivalence of 999-0x with the numbered linac buildings is an inference, not a statement in either source. The strip width matches the tunnel cross-section 'about 14 feet across' plus walls 'almost 2 feet thick' (src:geo-jlab-node-14330-cebaf-page, src:geo-jlab-accelerator-unique-page).
name: CEBAF accelerator tunnel, north straight section (building 999, part 01)
notes: Checks: none; no official straight-section length was found (the 1986-87 design papers give 240 m linacs, which is a design figure, not the as-built footprint).

summary.plain: The north straight section of the CEBAF tunnel, where one of the two superconducting linacs sits.
